upstream.author: PortablePorcelain
upstream.name: True LFSR
upstream.description: There is no feedback, so it can't be a linear feedback shift register. Since the array index that gets sent to the audio output never changes (it is always R[0]) and there are no calls to Array.shift, it's not a functional shift register. It is simply a roundabout way of calling random every 16th sample: <button class='code-text' data-songdata='{"sampleRate":48000,"mode":"Floatbeat"}'>t&15?n:n=2*random()&1</button>
